base_source: QEMU 10.0.13 with native/qemu-task-context and native/qemu-task-private applied
scope: Cooperative native x86 CPU slots and interrupt-frame ownership layered on the task-private RAM/fetch view. Not a vendor task manager or general DOS scheduler.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-scheduler-init
qmp_commands.purpose: Prepare migration state or initialize the scheduler from a stable FDBTASK1 monitor record.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-slot-capture
qmp_commands.purpose: Bind the stopped selected CPU context as a runnable native slot.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-slot-fork
qmp_commands.purpose: Fork a child slot from the current parent context, overriding only EIP, GPRs, and flags.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-slot-runnable
qmp_commands.purpose: Mark a stopped slot runnable or blocked; selection occurs at a native boundary.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-scheduler-observe
qmp_commands.purpose: Read stable scheduler slots, selected task, CPU context hashes, and frame ownership.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-context-read
qmp_commands.purpose: Read one stopped slot architectural context and interrupt frames.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-scheduler-disable
qmp_commands.purpose: Disable cooperative scheduling at a quiescent stopped state before host cleanup.

scheduler_protocol.selection: Native round-robin over runnable, nonblocked registered CPU slots; the FDBTASK1 anchor is written by QEMU. Guest tasks do not choose slots.
scheduler_protocol.preemption: Cooperative only; no timer/IRQ preemption claim.
scheduler_protocol.single_step: A single-stepped yield stops at the incoming context before its first instruction; QEMU single-step debug delivery is not duplicated.

supported_context: Single-vCPU x86 system TCG, real mode, V86, and non-PAE 32-bit protected mode; common GPR, flags, DR0-DR3/DR6/DR7, segment, control, x87 and SSE state is captured. AVX-family, MPX, AMX, PAE, long mode, SMM, nested guest mode and PKRU/PKS state are rejected.
interrupt_frames: Native-delivered frames are preflighted against private stack pages before guest writes, bound to SS identity, stack mask, gate width, size and ordered RAM backing pages, and checked before IRET. Task-gate switching is rejected while native scheduling is enabled.

migration.state: Task registry/private RAM, scheduler slots, canonical CPU contexts including per-slot DR0-DR3/DR6/DR7, runqueue and owned interrupt frames. Selected saved CPU context is rehydrated after load, including legacy x87 selectors absent from upstream CPU VMState.

build_receipt.build: Incremental Ninja build completed successfully with TMPDIR set to the external native-scheduler-runtime/tmp and `ninja -C <external native-scheduler-runtime/build> -j8 qemu-system-x86_64`; retained QEMU 10.0.13 study configuration. No CI run by patch author.

limitations: This is a bounded cooperative monitor interface, not QEMM/DESQview compatibility and not a general DOS scheduler.
No timer or asynchronous IRQ preemption is provided; machine-level interrupts remain global.
At most 16 CPU slots and the preceding private layer limit of 16 direct 4-KiB pages per task apply.
No PAE, long mode, SMM, nested guest, PKE/PKS, AVX/AVX-512, MPX or AMX contexts. Unsupported state fails closed.
Interrupt frames must map to direct private RAM. Task-gate switching is refused. Device DMA/IOMMU/GDB physical memory remain on the shared base view.
Only authored cooperating-monitor witnesses can support claims; no commercial task-manager compatibility is implied.
Per-slot debug state covers DR0-DR3, DR6 and DR7; guest hardware debug state is isolated across slots. GDB software breakpoints remain QEMU debugger state.
